field_principles.prior_dispositions: Keep the original thirteen outcomes and any missing-path diagnosis.
field_principles.promotion_score: Always zero; this milestone authorizes no automatic rollout, publication or generator-weight updates.
field_principles.random_seed: Freeze every fitting, sampling and resampling seed; null only when inapplicable.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: Bind code, protocol, input bytes, row shards and exact validation scope.

field_principles.schema: Use a versioned plain top-level schema with experiment_id, milestone and terminal status.
field_principles.small_ebm_training: Keep this field plain, reviewable, and bound by the artifact checksum.
field_principles.source_access_rows: Keep this field plain, reviewable, and bound by the artifact checksum.
field_principles.source_artifact_hashes: Preserve source identity, original classes and flags through typed sidecars.
field_principles.started_at_utc: Keep this field plain, reviewable, and bound by the artifact checksum.
field_principles.status: Keep this field plain, reviewable, and bound by the artifact checksum.
field_principles.task_contract_rows: Each independently parsed row makes count and ordering reviewable.
field_principles.title: Keep this field plain, reviewable, and bound by the artifact checksum.
field_principles.validation_receipts: Record actual scoped argv/environment, exit codes, durations and hashed logs, including adversarial_verify.
field_principles.verdict_class: Use positive | circular_positive | null | blocked | disqualified | partial. partial is only unfinished OWN retryable work.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: True when scoring authority is the deployed verifier; synthetic or exact-oracle benefit is circular.

.venv/bin/python -u -c 'import importlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys

marker = sys.argv.index("--exp7303-resolve-imports")
root = Path(sys.argv[marker + 1]).resolve()
sys.path[:] = [str(root / "python"), str(root), *sys.path]
resolved = {}
for name in sys.argv[marker + 2:]:
    module = importlib.import_module(name)
    resolved[name] = str(Path(module.__file__).resolve())
print(json.dumps({"resolved_imports": resolved}, sort_keys=True), flush=True)
allowed = (root / "python").resolve()
raise SystemExit(any(not Path(value).is_relative_to(allowed) for value in resolved.values()))
' --exp7303-resolve-imports . carnot.experiment_7434_v652_contract_methods
